name: Text Size And High Contrast Reach The Board And The WebView
note: D9 (2026-11-06): Settings → Display, four text steps and high contrast. The board caps (digit 1.2, notes 1.15) were measured on a 412px board; the WebView cap (1.3) is the one the layouts are gated to (U-1). Gate 3-22 measures the cells and the contrast on screen.

mutations.name: the board digit takes the full step
mutations.why: At 1.3 the digit font's 1.4em text box is 44.5px in a 41px cell — gate 3-12 counts that as a digit bigger than its cell.

mutations.name: the notes take the full step
mutations.why: By arithmetic a killer note at 1.3 is about 11.8px in 11.3px of room inside its dashed cage (not measured: the text box of a note is taller than its slot even at the normal size). This gate is the only one that holds the number.

mutations.name: the native plugin gets the board's capped step
mutations.why: The app's text would stop at 1.2 for no reason: the WebView has its own cap (1.3), and that is the one the layouts are gated to.
mutations.expectFailure: the native plugin gets the full step

mutations.name: the zoom is measured before the new one shows
mutations.why: The new text zoom shows on the next frame. Measured before it, --text-zoom keeps the old value and the board's digits are divided by the wrong number until the next start.
mutations.find: if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
mutations.expectFailure: measured again only after the plugin answered

mutations.name: the native cap goes past 1.3
mutations.why: U-1: past 1.3 the header and keypad grow until the board has no room; the layouts are gated to 1.3.
mutations.expectFailure: past 1.3 the board loses its room

mutations.name: onCreate ignores the kept step
mutations.why: The page would load at the phone's size and jump to the player's size when the web side catches up — or never, if it does not.
mutations.expectFailure: applies the kept step before the page loads

mutations.name: the plugin does not keep the step
mutations.why: Without it, MainActivity has nothing to apply at the next start.
mutations.expectFailure: keeps the step for the next start

mutations.name: the saved settings are not applied at start
mutations.why: A player who chose Large would see Normal at every start until they opened Settings.
mutations.expectFailure: applies the saved display settings at start

mutations.name: new players start at Large
mutations.why: Normal is what everyone had before D9; a different default changes every screen for players who never asked.
mutations.expectFailure: starts at the normal text size
